parts.html: The K-07 standard model is a contemporary solution for those who appreciate light interiors, a convenient use of space, and functional kitchen furniture. The white color, solid-color painted fronts, and a striking porcelain stoneware countertop form an elegant composition with clean geometric lines.

The model’s main feature is its U-shaped layout, which organizes the kitchen space on three sides. This layout provides a convenient arrangement of work surfaces, appliances, and storage systems, creating comfortable conditions for cooking.

White fronts visually lighten the furniture composition and help preserve a sense of spaciousness even with a large number of kitchen cabinets. The neutral color palette lets the kitchen pair with natural wood, stone textures, light wall finishes, and modern decorative materials.
The porcelain stoneware countertop underscores the model’s clean, understated character, adding an expressive texture and a practical work surface to the interior.

The upper and lower fronts are painted, and the carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard. The total length of the kitchen is 6.9 linear meters, providing ample space to store dishes, food, and kitchen utensils.
A cargo pull-out adds extra functionality. For comfortable everyday use, the kitchen features Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms and Atira Hettich drawers.
The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Without a separate island, the central part of the room remains open.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-07 standard model can be adapted to the dimensions of a specific room. When developing a custom design, we take into account the location of utility lines, appliances, and window and door openings, as well as the client’s storage preferences.
We offer a full range of services: kitchen furniture design, material selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
To order the K-07 kitchen or get a personalized price quote, contact DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
